Simulate coherent glass-camera and discrete fish-ID uncertainty scenarios

Source: R/joint-refractive-sensitivity.R
aqt_joint_refractive_scenarios.Rd

For each scenario: draw one physical calibration perturbation for EACH camera (shared across all video frames), one shared glass/water-index offset across the two views, camera-pixel localization errors, then reconstruct 3D reviewed correspondences through both glass interfaces. Optionally sample whole-suffix fish identity swaps, not independent identity labels at each frame. All SD inputs are externally assumed sensitivity parameters, NOT calibrated noise distributions.

Usage

aqt_joint_refractive_scenarios(
  view_a,
  view_b,
  correspondences,
  camera_a,
  camera_b,
  identity_events = NULL,
  pixel_sd = 0,
  center_sd = 0,
  glass_thickness_sd = 0,
  n_glass_sd = 0,
  n_water_sd = 0,
  draws = 50L,
  seed = 123L,
  max_skew_s = 0.02,
  max_ray_separation = Inf
)

Arguments

view_a, view_b

2D image aqt_tracks for distinct cameras.

correspondences

Externally reviewed cross-camera fish matches, optionally with tank_id and treatment fields.

camera_a, camera_b

Two aqt_flatport_camera optical models.

identity_events

Optional prospective swaps of reconstructed fish labels, using session_id,camera_id="REFRACTIVE3D", track_a,track_b, at_s,probability_swap. Only user-specified hypotheses are considered.

pixel_sd

One/two standard deviations in image pixels.

center_sd

One/two physical SDs of camera centre positions.

glass_thickness_sd

One/two physical glass thickness SDs.

n_glass_sd, n_water_sd

Shared dimensionless optical-index SDs.

draws

Number of coherent uncertainty scenarios (>= 10).

seed

Reproducible integer seed; caller RNG remains unchanged.

max_skew_s, max_ray_separation

Clock and physical ray QC limits.

Value

aqt_joint_refractive_scenarios with per-draw 3D tracks, physical calibration draws, diagnostics and assumptions.

Details

An optical draw that creates invalid glass or ray geometry FAILS explicitly; it is never silently omitted from ensemble summaries.
